title: Design System: We Present by COATI

display.purpose: Playfair Display serif, page banners and section H1/H2s only — never UI chrome or small labels.

body.purpose: Manrope, all paragraph copy and general UI text.

label.purpose: Manrope 600, uppercase, 0.22em tracking — the shared .kicker treatment for eyebrows, nav links, and badges.

shadows.name: card
shadows.purpose: The only shadow token in active use; nearly flat, applied at rest to most cards/panels. Depth otherwise comes from color/tint layering, not shadow growth.

motion.name: reveal
motion.purpose: The system's one consistent scroll-reveal signature; staggered per item within a section (delay = index * 0.06-0.1s).

motion.name: icon-spring
motion.value: spring(stiffness: 320, damping: 14), scale 1 to 1.12, rotate 0 to -6deg
motion.purpose: Icon hover micro-interaction, e.g. the About page's Value-journey stage cards.

motion.name: hover-lift
motion.purpose: Card hover lift (resort cards, tour cards, partner cards) — depth conveyed by motion, not added shadow.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Gold pill CTA — Register Interest, Send Inquiry, etc.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; background: #c9a24b; color: #3e2c55; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 14px 32px; font-family: Manrope, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; letter-spacing: 0.02em; font-weight: 600; text-decoration: none; transition: background 0.3s, box-shadow 0.3s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #ebdcb4; box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(201,162,75,0.2); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #c9a24b; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Amethyst-outline secondary action — Become a Partner, View All Destinations.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 14px 32px; border-radius: 9999px; border: 1px solid rgba(110,79,163,0.4); color: #6e4fa3; font-family: Manrope, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; text-decoration: none; background: transparent; transition: border-color 0.3s, background 0.3s; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { border-color: #6e4fa3; background: rgba(110,79,163,0.05); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #6e4fa3; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Card
components.description: Standard content card — resort/tour/partner listing card.
components.html:
Fushifaru Maldives

An intimate reef-fringed island built for slow mornings.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #fcfaf6; border: 1px solid rgba(110,79,163,0.1); border-radius: 16px; padding: 24px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(62,44,85,0.06); transition: transform 0.5s; } .ds-card:hover { transform: translateY(-8px); } .ds-card-title { font-family: 'Playfair Display', Georgia, serif; font-size: 20px; color: #3e2c55; margin: 0 0 8px; } .ds-card-body { font-family: Manrope, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.6; color: rgba(43,35,56,0.7); margin: 0; }

components.name: Input Field
components.description: Form text input with label, as used in Register/Contact/Inquiry forms.
components.css: .ds-field { display: block; font-family: Manrope, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; color: rgba(43,35,56,0.7); } .ds-field-label { display: block; margin-bottom: 8px; } .ds-input { width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(110,79,163,0.2); background: #fcfaf6; padding: 10px 16px; font-family: Manrope, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; color: #2b2338; outline: none; transition: border-color 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: #c9a24b; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(201,162,75,0.3); }

components.name: Kicker Label
components.description: The shared uppercase eyebrow/label treatment — section kickers, badges, stage markers.
components.css: .ds-kicker { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; font-family: Manrope, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.22em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #6e4fa3; } .ds-kicker-rule { width: 20px; height: 1px; background: rgba(110,79,163,0.5); }

components.name: Nav Link
components.description: Header navigation link with animated gold underline reveal.
components.css: .ds-nav-link { position: relative; font-family: Manrope, sans-serif; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.22em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #2b2338; text-decoration: none; padding-bottom: 4px; } .ds-nav-link::after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; bottom: 0; height: 1px; width: 0; background: #c9a24b; transition: width 0.3s; } .ds-nav-link:hover::after { width: 100%; }

narrative.overview:
We Present's visual system is a selective, hand-picked passage between destinations and the RU/CIS travel professionals invited to cross into them. It carries the formal warmth of the aubergine-and-gold palette and serif display type, but holds that warmth with restraint: one decisive photograph per section rather than busy compositions, generous negative space, near-flat surfaces. Confidence comes from composure, not density or noise.

The system rejects two easy failure modes: cold corporate B2B (it isn't — the palette is warm, the type is serif and humanist, photography carries real weight) and loud travel-marketing maximalism (it isn't that either — no stacked gradients, no crowded grids, no shouting CTAs). It sits in between: a quietly confident, editorially restrained invitation.
keyCharacteristics: Deep aubergine and warm gold carry the brand identity; amethyst and soft-lilac tints do the connective/structural work
Playfair Display serif for all headings, Manrope sans for everything else, no third family
Cards and panels are nearly flat at rest (shadow-card is barely visible); depth comes from color/tint layering, not shadow
One full-bleed, decisive photograph leads most sections rather than photo grids or stock-collage treatments
Motion is a single consistent fade-and-rise reveal, staggered per section, plus a small vocabulary of hover lifts and spring-based icon micro-interactions

rules.name: The Rare Gold Rule
rules.body: Gold is a spotlight, not a base color. It appears on primary CTAs, small accent marks, and hover glows — never as a large fill, never as small body text (contrast failure below ~4.5:1 at that size).

rules.name: The Tinted-Neutral Rule
rules.body: Section backgrounds alternate between ivory and lavender-mist/soft-lilac rather than white and gray — every neutral in this system carries the brand's own violet hue, never a true gray.

rules.name: The Kicker Rule
rules.body: Any small uppercase label in this system runs through the shared .kicker class (Manrope 600, 0.22em tracking, 0.75rem) — never a one-off text-xs uppercase tracking-wide improvisation.

dos: Do run every small uppercase label through the shared .kicker class — one label treatment system-wide.
Do keep muted body text at /70 opacity or higher against its background.
Do let one decisive photograph carry a section rather than a stock-photo collage; destination-neutral imagery where the copy itself is destination-neutral.
Do use the [0.22, 1, 0.36, 1] custom ease-out curve with a 0.9s duration and per-item stagger for scroll reveals.
Do reserve gold for actions and accents; let aubergine and amethyst carry structural/text weight.
donts: Don't use text-gold for small body text — it fails WCAG AA contrast at that size against light backgrounds.
Don't stack multiple scrim/gradient treatments on a single hero photo to fix nav-contrast — fix it once, architecturally, at the component that needs it.
Don't use near-identical adjacent tints (e.g. bg-lavender-mist next to bg-soft-lilac/40) for two sections that need a visible boundary.
Don't default to numbered eyebrows (01 / 02 / 03) as section scaffolding — reserve numbering for content that is genuinely a sequence.
